name: Birthday Block
description: displays upcoming users' birthdays in a block.
project_description:
Features 
 Birthday Block module provides a block and a page that displays upcoming user birthdays.

 Post-Installation 
 Upon installation of this module, two fields are created "Date of Birth" and "First Name" under "admin/config/people/accounts." The user needs to enable these fields from the "Manage Form Display" section. Also when the module is uninstalled these two fields also gets removed.
